ALTER view [CK].[vUserAuthProvider]( UserId, Scheme, LastUsed, UserName, CreationDate, PictureUrl ) as select UserId = 0, Scheme = 'Scheme (ProviderName when IsMultiScheme = 0)', LastUsed = 'non null datetime2(2)' -- (provider table).LastLoginTime from CKCore.tSystem where 1 = 0
union all select UserId, 'Twitter', LastLoginTime from CK.tUserTwitter where UserId > 0
union all -- Ignores empty PwdHash since they are failed password migration. select UserId, 'Basic', LastLoginTime from CK.tUserPassword where UserId > 0 and PwdHash != 0x
union all select UserId, 'Google', LastLoginTime from CK.tUserGoogle where UserId > 0 union all select UserId, 'Facebook', LastLoginTime from CK.tUserFacebook where UserId > 0;

ALTER view [CK].[vUserAuthProvider]( UserId, Scheme, LastUsed, UserName, CreationDate, PictureUrl ) as /* This header is useless once a real provider has been added. select UserId = 0, Scheme = 'Scheme (ProviderName when IsMultiScheme = 0)', LastUsed = 'non null datetime2(2)' -- (provider table).LastLoginTime -- from CKCore.tSystem where 1 = 0
union all*/ select UserId, 'Twitter', LastLoginTime, UserName = ScreenName, CreationDate, PictureUrl from CK.tUserTwitter where UserId > 0
union all -- Ignores empty PwdHash since they are failed password migration. select UserId, 'Basic', LastLoginTime, UserName = N'', CreationDate, PictureUrl='' from CK.tUserPassword where UserId > 0 and PwdHash != 0x
union all select UserId, 'Google', LastLoginTime, UserName, CreationDate, PictureUrl from CK.tUserGoogle where UserId > 0 union all select UserId, 'Facebook', LastLoginTime, UserName, CreationDate, PictureUrl from CK.tUserFacebook where UserId > 0;

Test.Text: create view CK.vDynObjPartTree( DynObjId, PartId, Depth, PartPath ) as with C as (select p.DynObjId, p.PartId, Depth = 1, PartPath = cast(p.PartId as varbinary(max)) from CK.tDynObjPart p where p.DynObjId > 0 union all select C.DynObjId, p.PartId, C.Depth + 1, PartPath + cast(p.PartId as varbinary(max)) from CK.tDynObjPart p inner join C on C.PartId = p.DynObjId) select C.DynObjId, C.PartId, C.Depth, C.PartPath from C;
Test.ResultText: create view CK.vDynObjPartTree( DynObjId, PartId, LayerId, Depth, PartPath ) as with C as (select p.DynObjId, p.PartId, p.LayerId, Depth = 1, PartPath = cast(p.PartId as varbinary(max)) from CK.vDynObjPart p where p.DynObjId > 0 union all select C.DynObjId, p.PartId, p.LayerId, C.Depth + 1, PartPath + cast(p.PartId as varbinary(max)) from CK.vDynObjPart p inner join C on C.PartId = p.DynObjId) select C.DynObjId, C.PartId, C.LayerId, C.Depth, C.PartPath from C;
